[{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Here is a comprehensive `README.md` documentation for your Employee Management REST API project.\n\n---\n\n# Employee Management REST API\n\n![Python Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.8%2B-blue.svg)\n![Framework](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-0.100%2B-009688.svg)\n![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-pytest-yellow.svg)\n\nA lightweight, high-performance RESTful API built with **FastAPI** and **Pydantic** for managing employee records. Features complete CRUD functionality, request validation, automatic API documentation, and unit tests using `pytest`.\n\n---\n\n## Table of Contents\n\n- [Features](#features)\n- [Tech Stack](#tech-stack)\n- [Project Structure](#project-structure)\n- [Getting Started](#getting-started)\n  - [Prerequisites](#prerequisites)\n  - [Installation](#installation)\n- [Running the Application](#running-the-application)\n- [Interactive API Documentation](#interactive-api-documentation)\n- [API Endpoints Reference](#api-endpoints-reference)\n- [Running Unit Tests](#running-unit-tests)\n- [Future Enhancements](#future-enhancements)\n\n---\n\n## Features\n\n- **Create Employee**: Add new employee records with unique IDs and data validation.\n- **List All Employees**: Retrieve a list of all registered employees.\n- **Get Employee Details**: Fetch specific employee details by ID.\n- **Update Employee**: Perform partial or full updates on employee fields.\n- **Delete Employee**: Remove employee records by ID.\n- **Data Validation**: Enforced schemas using Pydantic models.\n- **Automated Testing**: Integrated CRUD test suite using `pytest` and `TestClient`.\n\n---\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Framework**: [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)\n- **Data Validation**: [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/)\n- **ASGI Server**: [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)\n- **Testing**: [Pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) & [HTTPX](https://www.python-httpx.org/) (for `TestClient`)\n\n---\n\n## Project Structure\n\n```text\n.\n├── app.py          # FastAPI application logic and API endpoints\n├── test_app.py     # Integration and unit tests for the API\n└── README.md       # Project documentation\n```\n\n---\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\nEnsure you have Python 3.8 or higher installed on your machine.\n\n### Installation\n\n1. **Clone or download this repository** to your local machine.\n\n2. **Create and activate a virtual environment** (recommended):\n   ```bash\n   # On macOS/Linux\n   python3 -m venv venv\n   source venv/bin/activate\n\n   # On Windows\n   python -m venv venv\n   venv\\Scripts\\activate\n   ```\n\n3. **Install required dependencies**:\n   ```bash\n   pip install fastapi uvicorn pytest httpx\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## Running the Application\n\nStart the development server using **Uvicorn**:\n\n```bash\nuvicorn app:app --reload\n```\n\nThe API will be available at: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`\n\n---\n\n## Interactive API Documentation\n\nFastAPI provides automatic, interactive documentation. Once the app is running, access:\n\n- **Swagger UI**: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs](http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs)\n- **ReDoc**: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc](http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc)\n\n---\n\n## API Endpoints Reference\n\n### Employee Schemas\n\n#### **Create Employee Request Body (`Employee`)**\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `id` | `integer` | Yes | Unique identifier for the employee |\n| `name` | `string` | Yes | Full name of the employee |\n| `role` | `string` | Yes | Job title/role |\n| `department` | `string` | Yes | Department name |\n\n#### **Update Employee Request Body (`EmployeeUpdate`)**\n| Field | Type | Required | Description |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `name` | `string` | Optional | Updated name |\n| `role` | `string` | Optional | Updated role |\n| `department` | `string` | Optional | Updated department |\n\n---\n\n### Endpoints Overview\n\n| Method | Endpoint | Description | Status Code |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| `POST` | `/employees/` | Create a new employee | `201 Created` |\n| `GET` | `/employees/` | List all employees | `200 OK` |\n| `GET` | `/employees/{emp_id}` | Fetch a single employee by ID | `200 OK` / `404 Not Found` |\n| `PUT` | `/employees/{emp_id}` | Update employee attributes | `200 OK` / `404 Not Found` |\n| `DELETE` | `/employees/{emp_id}` | Delete an employee by ID | `200 OK` / `404 Not Found` |\n\n---\n\n### Example Requests & Responses\n\n#### 1. Create Employee\n**Request:**\n`POST /employees/`\n```json\n{\n  "id": 101,\n  "name": "Sarah Khan",\n  "role": "Senior Dev",\n  "department": "Engineering"\n}\n```\n\n**Response (`201 Created`):**\n```json\n{\n  "id": 101,\n  "name": "Sarah Khan",\n  "role": "Senior Dev",\n  "department": "Engineering"\n}\n```\n\n#### 2. Get All Employees\n**Request:**\n`GET /employees/`\n\n**Response (`200 OK`):**\n```json\n[\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n]\n```\n\n#### 3. Update Employee\n**Request:**\n`PUT /employees/101`\n```json\n{\n  "role": "Lead Architect"\n}\n```\n\n**Response (`200 OK`):**\n```json\n{\n  "id": 101,\n  "name": "Sarah Khan",\n  "role": "Lead Architect",\n  "department": "Engineering"\n}\n```\n\n#### 4. Delete Employee\n**Request:**\n`DELETE /employees/101`\n\n**Response (`200 OK`):**\n```json\n{\n  "message": "Employee deleted successfully",\n  "employee": {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Lead Architect",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## Running Unit Tests\n\nThe test suite in `test_app.py` verifies the complete lifecycle (CRUD) of employee records.\n\nTo execute tests, run:\n\n```bash\npytest\n```\n\n**Expected output:**\n```text\n============================== test session starts ==============================\ncollected 1 item\n\ntest_app.py .                                                             [100%]\n\n=============================== 1 passed in 0.12s ===============================\n```\n\n---\n\n## Future Enhancements\n\n- [ ] **Database Integration**: Replace the in-memory dictionary (`employees_db`) with a persistent database (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQLite via SQLAlchemy).\n- [ ] **Authentication & Authorization**: Add JWT token authentication to secure endpoints.\n- [ ] **Pagination & Search**: Implement pagination, filtering, and search capabilities for the `GET /employees/` route.\n- [ ] **Dockerization**: Add a `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` for easy container deployment.', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
